extra_production_file: apps/web/src/app/ai/ai.css (filter label layout only; not in pre-fix source hash set)

contextIds: Populated Trend context setup and context list reused the same heading ID and region name.
Give the populated list its own unique heading ID and matching labelledby reference.
productRegion: Product detail workspace and its inner product summary had the same accessible name.
Use a distinct Product opportunity workspace region name while retaining the visible product headings.
groups: A populated external-research badge collection named a generic div without a compatible role.
Use an explicitly named group; preserve labels, badges and server-derived recovery actions.
landmark: Routed components repeated the application shell main landmark.
Use a named section inside the existing sole application main; preserve headings, classes and navigation.
complementary: Generation summary aside was nested within another landmark/form.
Use a named Generation summary section, preserving controls and form semantics.
labels: Status selects and date inputs lacked associated visible labels.
Explicit unique for/id associations; group labels with their controls; retain filter query contract.
progress: Generic progress div carried ARIA properties without a compatible role.
Named progressbar with canonical current/min/max and textual step values.
headings: Visible Actions column heading with col scope; retain every action.
contrast: Empty-state foreground and small status text lost contrast on their actual backgrounds.
Reuse darker theme foreground; small website state text inherits its verified state color.
scroll: Overflowing table containers were not keyboard focusable.
Named tabindex=0 regions, unique accurate names and existing-theme visible focus; ArrowRight and Tab escape tested.
definitions: Description terms and definitions were children of a generic div.
Semantic dl wrapper without removing or changing data.
captions: Wide table intrinsic width made its caption exceed the mobile viewport and clip.
Size caption to an inline-size query container, allow wrapping and keep it at the scroll start; preserve full table columns and keyboard scrolling.
harness: Phase 4 proxy denied three automatic owner-scoped local context POSTs; not provider calls.
Permit only audited metadata payloads to exact canonical context endpoints, retain backend authentication, owner checks and deny acquisition/approvals.
